title: L Prize-Winning LED A19 Replacements FAQs
lineage: DOE reports approximately 940 lumens and 94 lumens per watt for the Philips L Prize bulb, explains its phosphor and expects $50 initial price in January 2012. Expected price is not actual transaction data.
